params.name: output_dir
params.description: Directory for decoded images; empty uses the plugin default.

params.name: input
params.description: Input pipeline: channelized IQ, real-IF audio, or raw packets.

params.name: crc_inits
params.description: CRC32 initial values to try, in order (for example 0x4EE4FDE1).

params.name: frame_header_len
params.description: CCSDS frame header length in bytes.

params.name: preview_interval_ms
params.description: Minimum interval between partial-image previews in raw-packet mode, ms.
